Accused-Opposite party No. 1 preferred the said appeal under section 476 B of the Code of Criminal Procedure against the order dated 21.6.1978 (22.6.1978) of the then Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Jhalakati taking cognizance against him of the offence punishable under sections 419, 420,467 and 468 of the Penal Code.
